_comment: Short notices for the home page. Gray edits this file; nothing else needs touching. Newest first — the page sorts by date anyway, shows at most three, and renders nothing at all when the list is empty.
_staleComment: If the newest notice is older than this, the whole section hides itself. A site showing 'latest news' from half a year ago looks abandoned, which is worse than showing none — and a lender cannot afford to look abandoned. Raise the number if a notice should stay up longer.
_fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, body (one or two sentences), href (optional, a page on this site), label (optional link text, defaults to 'Read more')

updates.title: Eight-week loans are now available
updates.body: You can borrow over eight weeks at 55% flat interest, alongside the existing one to four week terms. The calculator shows the full repayment before you apply.
